A family bakery for sourdough buns cakes

Hazel started baking in her kitchen in 2016 and sold her first loaves at the Kendal farmers' market. Today four of us bake through the night in Mill Yard, and we still use her first starter.
Questions we are often asked
Do you bake gluten-free bread?

Not yet. Our bakery is full of rye and wheat flour, so we can't promise anything is free from gluten.

Can I collect on Sundays?

Yes, from 8am until we sell out, usually by noon.
